entries.question: Welcome
entries.answer: Hello! Welcome to Arapoint. I'm your 24/7 AI support assistant. Ask me anything about our services — NIN/BVN, education results, VTU, wallet, CAC, and more. How can I help you?

entries.question: What is Arapoint?
variations: what can arapoint help me with
what kind of platform is arapoint
entries.answer:
Arapoint is Nigeria's trusted identity and utility verification platform. We offer:

• **NIN/BVN Lookup & Modification** — Check and update identity records
• **Education Results** — JAMB, WAEC, NECO, NABTEB, NBAIS result checking
• **JAMB Services** — Admission status, course change, regularization, O-level upload
• **VTU Services** — Airtime, data bundles, electricity bills, cable TV subscriptions
• **Airtime-to-Cash** — Convert airtime to wallet credit
• **Wallet** — Fund and manage your Arapoint wallet
• **CAC Registration** — Business name and company registration

Fast, reliable, and affordable — built for Nigerians.

entries.question: How do I contact Arapoint support?
variations: how can i talk to someone
entries.answer:
You can reach Arapoint support through:

• **This Chat** — Type 'agent' to be connected to a live human agent
• **Support Ticket** — Submit a ticket from your dashboard and we'll respond within 24 hours
• **Available Hours** — Monday to Saturday, 8am–8pm WAT

Our AI assistant is available 24/7 for instant answers.

entries.question: What are Arapoint's working hours?
variations: when can i chat with support
entries.answer:
Arapoint support hours:

• **AI Assistant** — Available 24/7, any time of day or night
• **Human Agents** — Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (WAT)
• **Sundays** — AI only; urgent tickets reviewed Monday morning

For issues outside working hours, submit a support ticket and an agent will respond at the start of the next business day.

entries.question: How do I create an account on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
Creating an Arapoint account is quick and free:

1. Visit the Arapoint website and click **Sign Up / Register**
2. Enter your **name, email address, and phone number**
3. Create a **strong password**
4. Verify your email address with the OTP sent to you
5. Log in and start using our services

Your wallet is created automatically once you register. No fees to sign up!

entries.question: How do I reset my password?
entries.answer:
To reset your Arapoint password:

1. Click **Forgot Password** on the login page
2. Enter the **email address** linked to your account
3. Check your email for a **password reset link** (check spam too)
4. Click the link and set a **new password**
5. Log in with your new password

If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or contact support.

entries.question: My account is locked, what do I do?
entries.answer:
If your account is locked:

1. **Try resetting your password** — sometimes this unlocks access
2. **Wait 30 minutes** — accounts are temporarily locked after multiple failed login attempts
3. **Contact Support** — type 'agent' here or submit a ticket with your registered email and phone number

Our team will verify your identity and restore access as quickly as possible.

entries.question: How do I update my profile information?
entries.answer:
To update your profile:

1. Log in to your Arapoint account
2. Click on your **Profile** or **Account Settings**
3. Edit the fields you want to update (name, phone, email)
4. Save your changes

Note: Changing your **email address** may require re-verification. If you're unable to update a field, please contact support as some fields may be restricted for security.

entries.question: Is Arapoint legitimate and safe?
variations: how do i know arapoint is real
entries.answer:
Yes, Arapoint is a fully legitimate and registered Nigerian digital services platform. Your security and trust are our top priorities:

• **Encrypted transactions** — All payments and data transfers are secured
• **No unauthorized sharing** — Your personal data is never shared without consent
• **Verified integrations** — We work with official government and financial APIs
• **Real support team** — Dedicated agents to resolve any issue

If you ever feel unsure, you can always contact our support team to verify.

entries.question: Does Arapoint have a mobile app?
variations: can i use arapoint on my phone
entries.answer: Currently, Arapoint is accessible through our **web platform** which is fully mobile-responsive — meaning it works great on your phone browser without needing to download anything. Simply visit our website on your phone's browser. A dedicated mobile app may be coming in the future. Stay tuned!

entries.question: How do I navigate the Arapoint dashboard?
variations: how to access services on arapoint
show me how to use arapoint
entries.answer:
The Arapoint dashboard is simple to navigate:

• **Home/Dashboard** — See your wallet balance and quick access to services
• **Identity Services** — NIN and BVN lookup and modification
• **Education** — JAMB, WAEC, NECO, NABTEB, NBAIS result checking
• **VTU** — Airtime, data, electricity, cable TV
• **Airtime to Cash** — Convert airtime to wallet credit
• **Wallet** — Fund your wallet and view balance
• **CAC** — Business registration services
• **Transactions** — View your history
• **Support** — Chat with us or submit a ticket

All services are accessible from the sidebar or top navigation menu.

entries.question: What is NIN?
entries.answer:
NIN stands for **National Identification Number**. It is an 11-digit unique number assigned to every Nigerian citizen and legal resident by NIMC (National Identity Management Commission). Your NIN:

• Identifies you uniquely in government databases
• Is required for SIM card registration, bank accounts, passport, and many official services
• Is your primary digital identity in Nigeria

You can use Arapoint to look up NIN details, retrieve your NIN slip, and get your vNIN.

entries.question: How do I look up a NIN on Arapoint?
variations: how do i check nin details
entries.answer:
To look up a NIN on Arapoint:

1. Log in to your Arapoint account
2. Go to **Identity Services** → **NIN Lookup**
3. Enter the NIN number you want to verify
4. Your wallet will be charged the service fee
5. The result will display within seconds

You'll get full details including name, photo, date of birth, and other linked information. You can also download a PDF of the result.

entries.question: My NIN lookup returned 'not found', what should I do?
entries.answer:
If your NIN lookup returns 'not found', here's what to check:

• **Double-check the NIN** — Make sure you entered all 11 digits correctly with no spaces
• **NIN not yet synced** — Newly issued NINs may take a few days to appear in the database
• **Unlinked NIN** — The NIN may not be fully registered in the national database yet
• **Wallet was charged** — If your wallet was deducted and no result returned, contact support immediately for a refund review

If the problem persists, contact Arapoint support with the NIN and your transaction reference.

entries.question: How do I get my NIN slip PDF?
variations: how to get nin slip online
entries.answer:
To get your NIN slip PDF on Arapoint:

1. Log in and navigate to **Identity Services** → **NIN Lookup**
2. Enter your NIN and complete the lookup
3. After results are displayed, click the **Download PDF** button
4. Your NIN slip will be downloaded to your device

The PDF is official and contains your photo, name, date of birth, and NIN details. You can print it for use where a physical NIN slip is required.

entries.question: What is vNIN and how do I get it?
entries.answer:
**vNIN (Virtual NIN)** is a 16-character alphanumeric code generated from your NIN. It was introduced by NIMC as a secure way to share your identity without revealing your raw 11-digit NIN.

To get vNIN on Arapoint:
1. Go to **Identity Services** → **vNIN Lookup**
2. Enter the required details
3. The vNIN result will be displayed and can be downloaded

vNIN is especially needed when linking your NIN to SIM cards, banks, or official systems that require identity verification.

entries.question: How much does NIN lookup cost?
entries.answer:
The NIN lookup fee is displayed on the service page before you confirm the transaction. Arapoint charges a small processing fee to cover the cost of accessing official NIMC databases.

To see the exact current price:
1. Log in to Arapoint
2. Go to **Identity Services** → **NIN Lookup**
3. The fee is shown before you proceed

Make sure your wallet has sufficient funds before initiating the lookup.

entries.question: How do I enroll for NIN if I don't have one?
entries.answer:
To enroll for NIN, you need to visit a NIMC enrollment center in person — this cannot be done online. Here's how:

1. Locate the nearest **NIMC enrollment center** in your state
2. Bring a valid government ID (international passport, driver's license, voter's card) or birth certificate
3. Complete the biometric registration (fingerprints and photo)
4. You'll receive your NIN immediately or within a few days

You can also enroll at NIMC-approved commercial banks. Once you have your NIN, use Arapoint to look it up and download your slip.

entries.question: Can I link my NIN to my phone number?
variations: how to link sim to nin
entries.answer:
Arapoint does not directly process SIM-NIN linkage, but here's how you can link your NIN to your SIM:

• **MTN** — Dial *785# or visit any MTN service center
• **Airtel** — Dial *121# or visit an Airtel outlet
• **Glo** — Dial *109# or visit a Glo outlet
• **9Mobile** — Dial *200# or visit a 9Mobile shop

You'll need your NIN ready. If you don't know your NIN, use Arapoint to look it up first.

entries.question: My NIN lookup was charged but I got no result
variations: charged for nin but no result
money removed for nin no result
wallet debited nin but no response
entries.answer:
We're sorry you experienced this. This can happen due to a temporary glitch in the identity database. Here's what to do:

1. **Check your transaction history** — confirm the deduction was made
2. **Retry the lookup** — sometimes a second attempt succeeds at no extra charge
3. **Contact Support** — share your transaction reference number and the NIN searched. Our team will investigate and process a refund or complete the lookup manually

We take such cases seriously and resolve them quickly.

entries.question: What is BVN?
entries.answer:
BVN stands for **Bank Verification Number**. It is an 11-digit unique number issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and NIBSS to every bank customer.

Your BVN:
• Links all your bank accounts in Nigeria
• Is used for identity verification in financial transactions
• Protects against banking fraud

Use Arapoint to look up BVN details or request BVN modification services.

entries.question: How do I look up a BVN on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To look up a BVN on Arapoint:

1. Log in to your Arapoint account
2. Navigate to **Identity Services** → **BVN Lookup**
3. Enter the 11-digit BVN number
4. Confirm the service fee deduction from your wallet
5. Results are displayed instantly

You'll see the account holder's name, date of birth, phone number, and other linked details. A downloadable PDF report is also available.

entries.question: BVN lookup returned not found, what do I do?
entries.answer:
If BVN lookup returns 'not found':

• **Check the BVN digits** — Ensure all 11 digits are entered correctly
• **The BVN may be deactivated** — Dormant accounts sometimes have inactive BVNs
• **New BVN** — Freshly created BVNs may take 24-48 hours to reflect
• **If wallet was charged** — Contact support immediately with the transaction reference for a refund review

Submit a support ticket with the BVN and your reference number if the issue persists.

entries.question: How do I download my BVN report PDF?
entries.answer:
To download your BVN report as PDF:

1. Complete a BVN lookup on Arapoint
2. After the results are displayed, click the **Download PDF** button
3. The PDF will be saved to your device

The PDF contains the BVN details, linked name, and other information from the result.

entries.question: What is BVN modification and how does it work?
entries.answer:
**BVN Modification** is a service that helps you update incorrect or outdated information on your BVN record — such as your name, date of birth, or phone number.

To request a BVN modification on Arapoint:
1. Go to **Identity Services** → **BVN Services** → **Modification Request**
2. Enter your BVN and NIN (optional but helpful)
3. Specify what needs to be changed (name, DOB, phone, etc.)
4. Submit the request
5. Arapoint processes the request through the appropriate agency

Modification requests take time to process. You'll receive updates on your request status in the history section.

entries.question: How long does BVN modification take?
variations: when will bvn modification be done
entries.answer:
BVN modification processing times vary:

• **Standard modifications** — Usually 3 to 10 business days
• **Complex corrections** — May take longer depending on the agency
• **Status updates** — You can check your modification history in your dashboard

If your request has been pending for more than 10 business days, please contact support with your request reference number.

entries.question: How do I check my JAMB result on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To check your JAMB result on Arapoint:

1. Log in to your account
2. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Result Check**
3. Enter your **JAMB Registration Number** and **year of exam**
4. Confirm the fee and proceed
5. Your result (score and subject scores) will be displayed

You can also download a PDF of your result. Ensure your wallet is funded before proceeding.

entries.question: JAMB result not showing or not found
entries.answer:
If your JAMB result is not showing:

• **Check your registration number** — Ensure it's correct with no extra spaces
• **Check the year** — Make sure you selected the right exam year
• **JAMB withheld results** — Some results are withheld by JAMB for malpractice; check the JAMB portal directly
• **Recent exams** — Results for very recent exams may not be available yet
• **If charged and no result** — Contact support with your reference number for assistance

If the issue continues, submit a ticket and our team will investigate.

entries.question: How do I check JAMB admission status?
variations: how to know if i got admission
entries.answer:
To check your JAMB admission status on Arapoint:

1. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Services** → **Admission Status**
2. Enter your **JAMB Registration Number**
3. The current admission status will be displayed — whether admitted, not admitted, or awaiting admission

Admission status is updated directly from the JAMB CAPS system. If you see 'Admitted', congratulations! If not, it may still be updated as institutions upload their lists.

entries.question: How do I change my JAMB course or institution?
variations: how to change jamb course and institution
entries.answer:
JAMB change of course and institution can be requested through Arapoint:

1. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Services** → **Change of Course/Institution**
2. Provide your JAMB registration number and current details
3. Select your desired course and institution
4. Pay the processing fee and submit the request

Note: JAMB change of course/institution is only available during the JAMB-approved change window period. Make sure you act within the deadline.

entries.question: What is JAMB direct entry and how do I process it?
entries.answer:
**JAMB Direct Entry (DE)** allows holders of OND, HND, NCE, and other equivalent qualifications to apply for 200 Level admission directly.

To process Direct Entry on Arapoint:
1. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Services** → **Direct Entry**
2. Provide your credentials and institution choices
3. Pay the service fee
4. Submit for processing

Direct Entry candidates bypass UTME. Your qualifications are verified and submitted to institutions of your choice through the JAMB CAPS system.

entries.question: How do I get my JAMB admission letter?
entries.answer:
To get your JAMB admission letter on Arapoint:

1. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Services** → **Admission Letter**
2. Enter your JAMB registration number
3. Your admission letter will be retrieved and can be downloaded as a PDF

Make sure your admission has been confirmed in the CAPS system before requesting the letter. Print multiple copies for different purposes.

entries.question: What is JAMB regularization and mutation?
entries.answer:
**JAMB Regularization** is for students who are already in school but did not originally use JAMB scores for admission, or whose records don't match the JAMB database.

**JAMB Mutation** corrects data errors in your JAMB records (wrong name, date of birth, etc.)

Both services are available on Arapoint under **Education → JAMB Services**. Submit the required documents and information for processing. These services typically take several working days.

entries.question: I need JAMB O-Level upload service
variations: how to upload o level to jamb
entries.answer:
Arapoint offers JAMB O-Level upload services:

1. Go to **Education** → **JAMB Services** → **O-Level Upload**
2. Provide your JAMB registration number and O-Level result details (examination number, year, grades)
3. Pay the service fee
4. Submit the request

This uploads your SSCE/O-Level results to the JAMB system. Processing typically takes 24-48 hours.

entries.question: What JAMB services are available on Arapoint?
variations: what can arapoint do for jamb
entries.answer:
Arapoint offers a comprehensive range of JAMB services:

• **JAMB Result Check** — View UTME scores and subject results
• **Admission Status** — Check if you've been admitted via CAPS
• **Admission Letter** — Download your JAMB admission letter
• **Change of Course/Institution** — Switch your first choice during the change window
• **Direct Entry** — Process DE application for ND/HND/NCE holders
• **O-Level Upload** — Upload WAEC/NECO results to JAMB system
• **Regularization** — For students not originally admitted via JAMB
• **Mutation** — Correct errors in your JAMB data

All services are processed through official JAMB channels.

entries.question: How do I check my WAEC result on Arapoint?
variations: how to check waec result online
entries.answer:
To check your WAEC result on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Education** → **WAEC Result Check**
2. Enter your **WAEC Examination Number** and **year of examination**
3. Pay the service fee from your wallet
4. Your subject results and grades will be displayed

You can download a PDF copy. Your WAEC examination number is on your WAEC scratch card or notification slip.

entries.question: My WAEC result is not found
entries.answer:
If your WAEC result is not found:

• **Verify your examination number** — Check for typos; it's usually printed on your WAEC card or result checker
• **Year selection** — Make sure the correct examination year is selected
• **Result withholding** — WAEC withholds results for suspected malpractice; check the WAEC portal
• **New results** — Very recent results may not yet be indexed
• **If charged** — Contact support with your transaction reference for investigation

If you're unsure of your exam number, check your WAEC scratch card or your school's records.

entries.question: What is WAEC GCE and how do I check the result?
entries.answer:
WAEC GCE (General Certificate of Education) is the external examination taken by private candidates and those who want to improve their grades. It is held annually in November/December.

To check WAEC GCE results on Arapoint:
1. Go to **Education** → **WAEC Result Check**
2. Enter your GCE examination number and year
3. Select the GCE exam type if prompted
4. Pay and view your results

GCE results are treated the same as regular WAEC SSCE by most institutions.

entries.question: How do I check my NECO result on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To check your NECO result on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Education** → **NECO Result Check**
2. Enter your **NECO Examination Number** and **year**
3. Pay the service fee from your wallet
4. Your NECO result with subjects and grades will be displayed

You can download a PDF of the result. Make sure your wallet is funded before starting.

entries.question: NECO result not found
entries.answer:
If your NECO result is not found:

• **Check your exam number** — The NECO examination number is on your result checker/slip
• **Verify the year** — Make sure you selected the correct examination year
• **Withheld results** — NECO withholds results for suspected malpractice
• **New results** — Recent results may take time to be indexed

Contact support with your exam number and transaction reference if the problem persists.

entries.question: How do I check my NABTEB result?
entries.answer:
To check NABTEB results on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Education** → **NABTEB Result Check**
2. Enter your **NABTEB Examination Number** and the year of exam
3. Pay the small service fee from your wallet
4. Your NABTEB result with subject grades will be displayed

NABTEB results are ideal for technical and vocational students. Download a PDF for your records.

entries.question: How do I check my NBAIS result?
entries.answer:
To check your NBAIS result on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Education** → **NBAIS Result Check**
2. Enter your **NBAIS Registration/Examination Number** and year
3. Pay the service fee and confirm
4. Your result will be displayed

NBAIS (National Board for Arabic and Islamic Studies) results are available through Arapoint's education services portal.

entries.question: How do I buy airtime on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To buy airtime on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **VTU** → **Airtime**
2. Select the **network** (MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9Mobile)
3. Enter the **phone number** to recharge
4. Enter the **amount** (minimum ₦50)
5. Confirm and the airtime is sent instantly from your wallet

Airtime purchases are instant. Supported networks: MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9Mobile.

entries.question: How do I buy data bundle on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To buy data bundles on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **VTU** → **Data**
2. Select your **network** (MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9Mobile)
3. Enter the **phone number**
4. Choose a **data plan** from the available options (daily, weekly, monthly)
5. Confirm the purchase — data is activated instantly

All major network data plans are available. Make sure your wallet has enough funds before proceeding.

entries.question: How do I pay my electricity bill on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To pay your electricity bill on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **VTU** → **Electricity**
2. Select your **electricity distribution company** (EKEDC, EEDC, IKEDC, PHEDC, AEDC, BEDC, etc.)
3. Choose **Prepaid or Postpaid**
4. Enter your **meter number**
5. Enter the **amount** to purchase
6. Confirm — your token will be displayed and sent to your registered phone

Save your token immediately as it may be needed for manual entry.

entries.question: How do I pay for cable TV on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To pay for cable TV on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **VTU** → **Cable TV**
2. Select your **provider** (DSTV, GOTV, Startimes)
3. Enter your **smart card/decoder number**
4. Select your **subscription package**
5. Confirm the payment — subscription is renewed instantly

Supported providers: DSTV, GOTV, Startimes. Make sure to enter your smart card number correctly to avoid crediting the wrong account.

entries.question: My airtime/data purchase was deducted but not received
variations: airtime purchase successful but no airtime
entries.answer:
We're sorry this happened. Here's what to do:

1. **Wait 5-10 minutes** — Some transactions take a few minutes to process
2. **Check your transaction status** in your Arapoint transaction history
3. **If 'Successful' but not received** — The network may be delayed; wait up to 30 minutes
4. **Contact your network provider** to confirm if any credit was received
5. **If still not resolved** — Contact Arapoint support with:
   - The phone number used
   - Amount purchased
   - Transaction reference number

We'll investigate and resolve it within 24 hours.

entries.question: My electricity token was not delivered
variations: paid for electricity but no token
entries.answer:
If your electricity token was not delivered:

1. **Check your SMS** — Token is usually sent via SMS to your registered phone number
2. **Check your Arapoint dashboard** — The token may be displayed in your transaction details
3. **Wait up to 10 minutes** — Some DISCOs have slight delays
4. **Contact support** if you still haven't received it after 15 minutes, with:
   - Meter number
   - Amount paid
   - Transaction reference

Our team will retrieve and resend your token.

entries.question: Which electricity companies can I pay on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
Arapoint supports all major electricity distribution companies (DISCOs) in Nigeria:

• **EKEDC** (Eko) — Lagos Island and environs
• **IKEDC** (Ikeja) — Lagos Mainland
• **EEDC** (Enugu) — Southeast
• **PHEDC** (Port Harcourt) — South-South
• **AEDC** (Abuja) — FCT and surroundings
• **BEDC** (Benin) — South-South/Southwest
• **KAEDCO** (Kaduna) — Kaduna State
• **KEDCO** (Kano) — Kano State
• **JEDC** (Jos) — Plateau and surroundings
• **YEDC** (Yola) — Northeast

All DISCOs support both prepaid and postpaid meter payments.

entries.question: Can I buy data for someone else?
entries.answer: Yes! You can buy airtime and data for any phone number on Arapoint — not just your own. Simply enter the recipient's phone number in the designated field when making the purchase. The airtime or data will be sent directly to that number.

entries.question: Is VTU airtime purchase cheaper on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
Yes! Arapoint VTU airtime is typically offered at a **slight discount** compared to face value. For example, buying ₦1,000 airtime may cost you slightly less from your wallet, giving you a small saving on every purchase.

Data bundle prices are also competitive. This is one of the advantages of using Arapoint for your VTU needs instead of buying physical recharge cards.

entries.question: What is the minimum airtime I can buy?
entries.answer:
The minimum airtime you can purchase on Arapoint is **₦50**. For data bundles, the minimum depends on the network and plan selected — some plans start as low as ₦50 as well.

There is no maximum limit for airtime/data purchases in a single transaction, as long as your wallet balance is sufficient.

entries.question: What is Airtime to Cash and how does it work?
variations: how does airtime to cash work
entries.answer:
**Airtime to Cash (A2C)** lets you convert airtime from any network into wallet credit on Arapoint. Here's how it works:

1. Go to **Airtime to Cash** on your dashboard
2. Select your **network** and enter the **airtime amount** to convert
3. You'll see the exact wallet credit you'll receive (at the current rate)
4. **Transfer the airtime** to our designated network number shown on screen
5. Once confirmed, your wallet is credited

A2C is great for converting excess airtime received as gifts into usable credit.

entries.question: What is the Airtime to Cash rate?
variations: how much will i get for my airtime
entries.answer:
The Airtime to Cash rate varies by network and fluctuates slightly. Typically:

• **MTN** — ~75-80% of airtime value
• **Airtel** — ~72-78% of airtime value
• **Glo** — ~70-75% of airtime value
• **9Mobile** — ~70-75% of airtime value

The exact rate for your transaction is always shown **before you confirm**. So you'll know exactly what you'll receive before you send the airtime.

entries.question: How long does Airtime to Cash take?
variations: when will a2c credit my wallet
entries.answer:
Airtime to Cash processing time:

• **Typical** — 5 to 30 minutes after airtime transfer is confirmed
• **Peak hours** — May take up to 2 hours during high traffic
• **Maximum** — If not credited within 4 hours, contact support

The status shows as **Pending** until the airtime is verified and credited to your wallet.

entries.question: My A2C request is still pending after a long time
variations: airtime sent but a2c not done
entries.answer:
If your A2C request has been pending for more than 4 hours:

1. **Check your transaction history** to confirm the status
2. **Confirm you sent the airtime** to the correct Arapoint number shown on screen
3. **Contact support** with:
   - The A2C request ID/reference
   - Network used
   - Amount of airtime sent
   - Time of airtime transfer

Our team will investigate the airtime receipt and credit your wallet accordingly.

entries.question: Minimum and maximum amount for Airtime to Cash
entries.answer:
Airtime to Cash limits:

• **Minimum** — ₦100 worth of airtime
• **Maximum** — ₦50,000 per transaction (may vary by network)

These limits apply per single request. You can make multiple requests if you need to convert more than the maximum. Always check the current limits shown on the A2C page before initiating.

entries.question: What networks are supported for Airtime to Cash?
variations: can i do a2c for airtel
what networks for airtime to cash
entries.answer:
Airtime to Cash on Arapoint supports all four major Nigerian networks:

• **MTN**
• **Airtel**
• **Glo**
• **9Mobile**

Just select your network when creating the A2C request, and Arapoint will give you the number to transfer the airtime to for each specific network.

entries.question: How do I transfer airtime for A2C?
variations: how to send airtime for a2c
how to transfer airtime on mtn
entries.answer:
To transfer airtime for your A2C request:

• **MTN** — Dial *600*[Arapoint number]*[amount]# or use Me2U: *600*[number]*[PIN]#
• **Airtel** — Dial *432*[amount]*[Arapoint number]# or Share and Sell
• **Glo** — Dial *131*[Arapoint number]*[amount]#
• **9Mobile** — Dial *223*[PIN]*[Arapoint number]*[amount]#

The specific Arapoint number to send to is shown in your A2C request on your dashboard. Transfer exactly the amount shown in the request.

entries.question: I sent airtime but my A2C request was cancelled
variations: my a2c was cancelled but i sent airtime
entries.answer:
We're sorry this happened. Please contact support immediately with:

1. **A2C Request ID/Reference** from your transaction history
2. **Proof of airtime transfer** — screenshot of the transfer confirmation SMS
3. **Network, amount, and time** of transfer

Our team will verify the transfer on our end and credit your wallet or resolve the issue. Do not create a new A2C request until this is resolved.

entries.question: Can I do A2C for someone else?
variations: someone else do a2c for me
entries.answer: Yes! You can initiate an A2C request on Arapoint and have someone else (or yourself from a different number) transfer the airtime to the provided number. The wallet credit goes into your Arapoint wallet. Just make sure the correct amount is transferred for the request to be matched.

entries.question: How do I fund my Arapoint wallet?
entries.answer:
To fund your Arapoint wallet:

1. Log in and go to **Wallet** → **Fund Wallet**
2. You'll see your **unique virtual account number** (bank name and account number)
3. Transfer any amount from your bank (via internet banking, USSD, or mobile app) to that account number
4. Your wallet is credited **automatically and instantly** once the bank processes the transfer

Alternatively, you can pay via card or other payment methods shown on the funding page. Minimum funding is ₦100.

entries.question: My wallet was not credited after a bank transfer
variations: payment received but wallet not funded
i sent money but wallet empty
entries.answer:
If your wallet wasn't credited after a bank transfer:

1. **Wait 5-15 minutes** — Some banks have slight delays in processing
2. **Verify the account number** — Ensure you transferred to the correct virtual account number shown on Arapoint (each user has a unique account)
3. **Check your bank statement** — Confirm the transfer was debited from your account
4. **Contact support** with:
   - Amount transferred
   - Date and time of transfer
   - Your bank name
   - Transaction reference/receipt

Our team will trace the payment and credit your wallet within a few hours.

entries.question: How do I check my wallet balance?
variations: how much is in my wallet
entries.answer:
Your wallet balance is displayed on your **Arapoint dashboard** as soon as you log in. You can also find it in the **Wallet** section of the app.

The balance updates in real-time after every transaction — funding, purchases, or service charges.

entries.question: How do I withdraw from my Arapoint wallet?
entries.answer:
To withdraw from your Arapoint wallet:

1. Go to **Wallet** → **Withdraw**
2. Enter the **amount** you want to withdraw
3. Provide your **bank account details** (bank name, account number, account name)
4. Confirm the withdrawal
5. Funds will be sent to your bank account within a few minutes to a few hours

Note: There may be a small withdrawal processing fee. Minimum withdrawal amounts apply.

entries.question: My wallet was debited but service was not delivered
variations: money gone but service not rendered
entries.answer:
We're sorry you experienced this. Please follow these steps:

1. **Check your transaction history** — Note the transaction reference and exact amount deducted
2. **Wait a few minutes** — Some services have slight delivery delays
3. **Contact support immediately** with:
   - Transaction reference number
   - Service purchased
   - Amount deducted
   - Date and time

Our team will investigate and either complete the service delivery or process a refund to your wallet within 24 hours.

entries.question: What is my virtual account number?
entries.answer:
Your Arapoint virtual account number is your **dedicated bank account** for funding your wallet. To find it:

1. Log in to Arapoint
2. Go to **Wallet** → **Fund Wallet**
3. Your **unique virtual account number and bank name** are displayed there

This account is unique to you. Transfers made to it automatically credit your Arapoint wallet. Keep this number saved for easy future top-ups.

entries.question: Is there a minimum wallet balance required?
entries.answer:
There is no mandatory minimum balance in your Arapoint wallet — you only need to have enough funds to cover the specific service you want to use. Each service displays its fee before you proceed, so you can always fund accordingly.

For smooth usage, we recommend maintaining at least ₦500 in your wallet at all times.

entries.question: Is my Arapoint wallet secure?
variations: is my money safe in arapoint wallet
entries.answer:
Yes, your Arapoint wallet is fully secure:

• **Encrypted transactions** — All wallet operations use SSL/TLS encryption
• **PIN protection** — Transaction PIN required for sensitive operations
• **Activity monitoring** — Suspicious activity triggers alerts
• **No third-party access** — Only you can initiate wallet transactions

If you notice any unauthorized transaction, contact support immediately by typing 'agent'.

entries.question: How long does wallet funding take to reflect?
variations: how long for wallet to credit
entries.answer:
Wallet funding timing:

• **Bank transfer to virtual account** — Typically instant (within 1-5 minutes), but sometimes up to 15 minutes
• **Card payment** — Usually instant after bank authorization
• **Some banks** — May take up to 30 minutes due to inter-bank processing

If your wallet isn't credited after 30 minutes, contact support with your payment receipt.

entries.question: How do I register a business name on Arapoint?
variations: how to cac register on arapoint
entries.answer:
To register a business name on Arapoint:

1. Go to **CAC Services** → **Business Name Registration**
2. Enter your **proposed business name(s)** (provide 2-3 alternatives)
3. Fill in the **business activity/type** and **proprietor details**
4. Provide required documents (ID, address)
5. Pay the registration fee
6. Submit the application

Arapoint submits your application to the CAC. Registration typically takes 7-14 business days. You'll receive your CAC certificate when complete.

entries.question: How do I register a company (RC) on Arapoint?
variations: how to register a company in nigeria
entries.answer:
To register a Limited Liability Company on Arapoint:

1. Go to **CAC Services** → **Company Registration**
2. Provide your **proposed company name(s)**
3. Enter details about **directors and shareholders** (names, ID, addresses)
4. Select your **share capital and structure**
5. Upload required documents (valid IDs for all directors, passport photos, address proof)
6. Pay the registration fee
7. Submit the application

Company registration typically takes 14-21 business days.

entries.question: How long does CAC registration take?
entries.answer:
CAC registration timelines on Arapoint:

• **Business Name** — 7 to 14 business days
• **Company (RC)** — 14 to 21 business days
• **Expedited** — Contact support to inquire about faster processing

Timelines depend on CAC's processing queue. You'll be notified when your registration is complete and documents are ready for download.

entries.question: My CAC registration has been taking too long
variations: what is happening with my cac
entries.answer:
We understand your frustration. CAC registration delays sometimes occur due to CAC's internal processing queue. Here's what to do:

1. **Check your registration status** in your Arapoint dashboard under CAC Services
2. **Contact support** if it has exceeded the expected timeframe, providing your:
   - Registration reference number
   - Business/company name applied for
   - Date of application

Our team will follow up with CAC and give you a status update.

entries.question: What documents do I need for CAC business name registration?
variations: what do i need to register business
entries.answer:
For CAC Business Name Registration, you'll need:

• **Valid government-issued ID** — NIN card, international passport, driver's license, or voter's card
• **Passport photograph** — Clear recent photo of the proprietor
• **Proposed business names** — At least 2 alternatives
• **Business description** — What your business does
• **Business address** — Physical/registered address
• **Proprietor's date of birth and nationality**

For Company Registration, additional documents include directors' IDs and share capital details.

entries.question: What payment methods does Arapoint accept?
entries.answer:
Arapoint accepts the following payment methods:

• **Bank Transfer** — To your unique virtual account number (instant crediting)
• **Debit/Credit Card** — Visa, Mastercard, Verve
• **USSD** — Pay via your bank's USSD code
• **Wallet** — Use your pre-funded Arapoint wallet for all service payments

The wallet is the primary payment method for services. Fund your wallet first and then use it for purchases.

entries.question: How do I get a refund?
entries.answer:
To request a refund on Arapoint:

1. **Contact Support** — Type 'agent' in this chat or submit a support ticket
2. Provide:
   - Transaction reference number
   - Amount involved
   - Reason for refund request
   - Proof if applicable
3. Our team reviews refund requests within **24-48 hours**
4. Approved refunds are credited to your **Arapoint wallet** first, then can be withdrawn

Note: Completed services (result checks, verified identity lookups) are generally non-refundable. Refunds are typically processed for failed or undelivered services.

entries.question: My transaction shows failed but my wallet was debited
entries.answer:
This is a known scenario that happens during network hiccups. Here's what happens:

1. The payment is sent but the confirmation fails to reach Arapoint's server
2. The money is deducted from your wallet but the service isn't delivered

**What to do:**
1. Wait 10-30 minutes and refresh — sometimes it auto-resolves
2. Check your transaction history for the failed transaction reference
3. Contact support with the reference number — we'll trace it and either re-process the service or refund your wallet

entries.question: How do I view my transaction history?
entries.answer:
To view your transaction history:

1. Log in to Arapoint
2. Go to **Transactions** or **History** from the dashboard
3. You'll see a list of all your transactions including:
   - Service type
   - Amount
   - Status (success, failed, pending)
   - Date and time
   - Reference number

You can filter by date range or service type for easier searching.

entries.question: What is a transaction reference?
entries.answer:
A **transaction reference** is a unique code assigned to every transaction on Arapoint. It looks like a combination of letters and numbers.

Where to find it:
• In your **Transaction History** — listed next to each transaction
• In the **transaction confirmation** shown immediately after payment
• In any **receipt or notification** sent by Arapoint

Always quote your transaction reference when contacting support about a specific payment.

entries.question: How long does a refund take?
entries.answer:
Refund timelines on Arapoint:

• **Wallet reversal** — Usually within 24-48 hours of approval
• **Bank refund** (if applicable) — 3-7 business days depending on your bank
• **Complex cases** — May take up to 7 business days

You'll receive a notification once your refund is processed. Contact support if you haven't received your refund after 7 business days.

entries.question: Can I get a refund for a completed service?
variations: can i refund after using service
entries.answer:
Generally, **completed services are non-refundable** because the service has already been delivered (e.g., a NIN lookup result was returned, airtime was credited, etc.).

Refunds are typically only processed for:
• Failed or undelivered services
• Duplicate charges
• System errors where payment was taken but no service was rendered

If you believe there was an error even in a 'completed' transaction, contact support with full details and we'll investigate.

entries.question: I noticed unauthorized activity on my account
variations: someone else is in my account
entries.answer:
Act immediately if you notice unauthorized activity:

1. **Change your password immediately** — Go to Profile → Change Password
2. **Contact support now** — Type 'agent' to be connected to a live agent
3. **Do not share your PIN or password** with anyone, including people claiming to be Arapoint staff
4. **Review all recent transactions** and note any unauthorized ones
5. **Submit a security report ticket** with details of the suspicious activity

We will freeze suspicious activity and investigate thoroughly. Your funds are protected.

entries.question: Arapoint is asking for my PIN or password
entries.answer:
**IMPORTANT WARNING:** Arapoint will NEVER ask for your password, transaction PIN, OTP, or full card details — not via chat, phone, email, or any other channel.

If anyone claiming to be Arapoint is asking for these details:
• **Do not share anything** — It is a phishing/fraud attempt
• **Block and report** — Report the number/account immediately
• **Contact our official support** through this official chat

Stay safe and never share sensitive details with anyone.

entries.question: How do I keep my Arapoint account safe?
entries.answer:
Tips to keep your Arapoint account safe:

• **Use a strong password** — Mix letters, numbers, and symbols
• **Never share your password or PIN** with anyone
• **Avoid logging in on public/shared computers**
• **Always log out** after using the platform on a shared device
• **Watch out for phishing** — Only use the official Arapoint website
• **Report suspicious messages** that claim to be from Arapoint

Your security is our priority. Contact support immediately if anything feels wrong.

entries.question: I did not receive my OTP
entries.answer:
If you didn't receive your OTP:

1. **Wait 1-2 minutes** — OTPs can sometimes be delayed
2. **Check your spam/junk folder** (for email OTPs)
3. **Ensure your phone number is correct** — Verify it matches your registered number
4. **Click Resend OTP** on the page (usually available after 60 seconds)
5. **Check if your phone has network coverage** — No signal means no SMS

If OTP still doesn't arrive after 3 resend attempts, contact support.

entries.question: My OTP has expired
entries.answer:
OTPs on Arapoint typically expire after **5-10 minutes**. If yours has expired:

1. Go back to the login/verification page
2. Click **Resend OTP** to get a fresh one
3. Use the new OTP promptly

Don't refresh the page while waiting — it may restart the process.

entries.question: What are education PINs and how do I get them?
entries.answer:
**Education PINs** (scratch card PINs or result checker tokens) are unique codes used to access official result portals.

However, when you check results on Arapoint, you **don't need a PIN** — we handle the verification process directly on your behalf. You simply pay the service fee and we retrieve your results instantly.

If you need original scratch card PINs for official portals, contact Arapoint support — we may be able to assist.

entries.question: Where can I see Arapoint's service prices?
entries.answer:
Service prices are displayed in real-time on each service page before you confirm any transaction. You'll always see the exact fee before committing.

For a general overview:
• Each service page shows the current fee
• Prices are competitive and transparent — no hidden fees
• Wallet deductions only happen after you explicitly confirm

To see prices, log in and browse to any service — the fee is always shown on the confirmation screen.

entries.question: Are there hidden charges on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
No, Arapoint has **absolutely no hidden charges**. Here's our pricing promise:

• Every service fee is displayed clearly before you confirm
• You'll see exactly what will be deducted before clicking 'Confirm'
• No surprise deductions
• No subscription fees for basic usage

If you ever see an unexpected deduction, contact support immediately with the transaction reference and we'll investigate.

entries.question: Does Arapoint charge for wallet funding?
variations: is there a charge to add money
how much to top up wallet
entries.answer:
Arapoint does not charge you directly for funding your wallet. However:

• **Bank transfer to virtual account** — Free from Arapoint's side (your bank may charge interbank fees)
• **Card payment** — A small processing fee may apply depending on the payment gateway

The most cost-effective way to fund your wallet is via **bank transfer** to your virtual account — it's usually free and credits instantly.

entries.question: The Arapoint website is not loading
entries.answer:
If the Arapoint website isn't loading:

1. **Check your internet connection** — Try loading another website to confirm
2. **Clear your browser cache** — Press Ctrl+Shift+Delete and clear cache/cookies, then retry
3. **Try a different browser** — Chrome, Firefox, or Edge
4. **Try a different network** — Switch between WiFi and mobile data
5. **Disable VPN** — If you're using a VPN, try turning it off

If the issue persists for more than an hour, contact support.

entries.question: I keep getting an error message on Arapoint
entries.answer:
If you're getting error messages on Arapoint:

1. **Refresh the page** and try again — temporary errors often resolve themselves
2. **Note the error message** — Screenshot it if possible
3. **Clear browser cache** and try again
4. **Try a different browser or device**
5. **Contact support** with the error message details, the page where it occurred, and your browser/device type

Provide as much information as possible so our team can investigate and fix it quickly.

entries.question: Why am I not receiving Arapoint notifications?
entries.answer:
If you're not receiving Arapoint notifications:

1. **Check your spam/junk folder** — Email notifications may be filtered there
2. **Verify your email and phone** — Ensure they're correctly saved in your profile
3. **Check notification settings** — Enable notifications in your account settings
4. **Allow Arapoint emails** — Whitelist our email domain in your mail settings
5. **SMS delivery** — Check if your phone network is active and receiving SMS

entries.question: How do I track my support ticket?
entries.answer:
To track your support ticket:

1. Log in to Arapoint
2. Go to **Support** → **My Tickets**
3. You'll see all your submitted tickets with their current status:
   - **Open** — Under review by support team
   - **In Progress** — Being actively worked on
   - **Resolved** — Issue has been fixed
   - **Closed** — Ticket closed

You'll also receive email notifications when your ticket status changes.

entries.question: How do I escalate my issue to a human agent?
variations: i want to talk to someone
entries.answer:
To escalate your issue to a human agent:

• **Type 'agent'** in this chat — I'll connect you immediately
• **Submit a priority ticket** — Mark your ticket as 'Urgent' when submitting

Human agents are available Monday to Saturday, 8am–8pm WAT. Outside these hours, submit a ticket and an agent will respond first thing next morning.

entries.question: How do I become an A2C agent?
entries.answer:
To become an Arapoint A2C (Airtime-to-Cash) agent:

1. Contact Arapoint support through this chat or submit a ticket expressing your interest
2. Our team will share the **agent program requirements** with you
3. Complete the **agent registration process**
4. Access the **dedicated agent portal** to process A2C transactions for clients

Agents earn commission on each A2C transaction processed. Contact support to get started.

entries.question: What documents do I need to verify my identity on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
For identity verification on Arapoint (KYC), you may need:

• **NIN** — National Identification Number (required for most services)
• **Valid government ID** — NIN card, international passport, driver's license, or voter's card
• **Passport photograph** — Clear recent photo
• **BVN** — For some financial service verification

The specific documents required depend on the service or level of verification needed.

entries.question: What does 'pending' status mean?
entries.answer:
**Pending** means your transaction or request is still being processed — it hasn't completed yet but hasn't failed either. Common pending situations:

• **Wallet credit** — Bank transfer received but not yet confirmed
• **A2C request** — Airtime transfer being verified
• **Service delivery** — Result or token being retrieved from the database
• **CAC/JAMB** — Application submitted and awaiting agency processing

Most pending statuses resolve within minutes to a few hours. If yours is pending beyond the expected timeframe, contact support.

entries.question: What does 'failed' status mean?
entries.answer:
**Failed** means the transaction did not complete successfully. Reasons a transaction may fail:

• Insufficient wallet balance
• Network/system error at the time of processing
• Incorrect information provided (wrong meter number, BVN, etc.)
• The service provider returned an error

If your wallet was debited on a failed transaction, contact support immediately with the transaction reference — we'll investigate and process a refund if applicable.

entries.question: What does 'successful' status mean?
entries.answer:
**Successful** means your transaction was completed and the service was delivered. If you see a 'Successful' status but haven't received the service (e.g., airtime not credited, token not received), it may be a delivery delay.

Wait 5-15 minutes after a successful status. If the service still isn't delivered, contact support with your transaction reference.

entries.question: Tips for using Arapoint smoothly
entries.answer:
Tips for a smooth Arapoint experience:

1. **Keep your wallet funded** — Always have enough balance before starting a service request
2. **Double-check inputs** — Verify phone numbers, NIN, BVN, meter numbers before submitting
3. **Save transaction references** — Screenshot or note every transaction reference
4. **Check service fees upfront** — All fees are shown before you confirm
5. **Use a stable internet connection** — Avoid mobile data drops during transactions
6. **Log out on shared devices** — Protect your account on public computers
7. **Contact support early** — If something seems wrong, don't wait — reach us immediately

entries.question: What is the difference between NIN and BVN?
entries.answer:
**NIN vs BVN — Key Differences:**

| Feature | NIN | BVN |
|---|---|---|
| Full Name | National Identification Number | Bank Verification Number |
| Issued By | NIMC | CBN/NIBSS |
| Purpose | Government identity | Banking identity |
| Who Needs It | All Nigerians/residents | Anyone with a Nigerian bank account |
| Where Used | Government services, SIM, travel | Banks, financial transactions |

Both are 11-digit numbers but serve different purposes. You can check both on Arapoint.

entries.question: Can I use Arapoint outside Nigeria?
entries.answer:
Yes, you can access the Arapoint website from anywhere in the world with an internet connection. However, most of our services are designed for Nigerian identity and utility systems:

• **Identity verification** (NIN/BVN) — Works for Nigerian records regardless of where you are
• **VTU (airtime/data/bills)** — For Nigerian numbers and DISCOs
• **CAC registration** — Can be initiated remotely
• **Education results** — Available from anywhere

Wallet funding may require a Nigerian bank account. Contact support for specific diaspora use cases.

entries.question: How do I make a complaint about Arapoint?
entries.answer:
We're sorry to hear you're dissatisfied. Your feedback is very important to us. Here's how to make a formal complaint:

1. **Chat with support** — Type 'agent' here to speak directly with a human agent
2. **Submit a ticket** — Use the Support section in your dashboard with full details of your complaint
3. **Include details** — Transaction references, dates, amounts, and a clear description of the issue

All complaints are taken seriously and reviewed by our team. We commit to responding within 24-48 hours.

entries.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
entries.answer:
To enhance your account security with 2FA:

1. Log in to Arapoint
2. Go to **Profile** → **Security Settings**
3. Enable **Two-Factor Authentication**
4. Choose your preferred 2FA method (SMS or authenticator app)
5. Follow the setup instructions

With 2FA enabled, you'll need to verify your identity each time you log in, making your account much more secure.

entries.question: How do I change my phone number on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To change your phone number on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Profile** → **Account Settings**
2. Click on **Edit** next to your phone number
3. Enter your new phone number
4. Verify with an OTP sent to the new number
5. Save changes

If you no longer have access to your old phone number and are locked out, contact support with your account email and ID proof.

entries.question: How do I change my email address on Arapoint?
entries.answer:
To change your email address on Arapoint:

1. Log in and go to **Profile** → **Account Settings**
2. Click **Edit** next to your email address
3. Enter your new email address
4. A verification link will be sent to the new email
5. Click the link to confirm and save changes

Note: You'll need access to both your old and new email during the change process. Contact support if you've lost access to your old email.

entries.question: How do I delete my Arapoint account?
variations: i want to delete my account
entries.answer:
To delete your Arapoint account:

1. **Withdraw any remaining wallet balance** first
2. Contact **Arapoint support** — type 'agent' or submit a ticket
3. Request account deletion and provide a reason
4. Our team will verify your identity and process the deletion

Note: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data, transaction history, and wallet balance will be lost. Make sure to withdraw your wallet before requesting deletion.

entries.question: Does Arapoint have a referral program?
entries.answer:
For the latest information about Arapoint's referral or affiliate program, please check the **Refer & Earn** section of your dashboard if available, or contact our support team.

Type 'agent' to speak with a human agent who can give you the most current details on any referral scheme.

entries.question: How do I give feedback about Arapoint?
entries.answer:
We love hearing from you! To give feedback about Arapoint:

• **Support Chat** — Share your thoughts directly here
• **Support Ticket** — Submit a feedback ticket from your dashboard
• **Rating** — If prompted after a transaction, rate your experience

Your feedback helps us improve our services for all Nigerians. Thank you for taking the time to share!

entries.question: What is my account email?
entries.answer:
Your registered email is the one you used when you created your Arapoint account. You can view it by:

1. Logging in to Arapoint
2. Going to **Profile** → **Account Settings**
3. Your registered email is shown there

If you've forgotten which email you used and can't log in, contact support with your registered phone number and we'll help you recover your account.

entries.question: My account was created but I can't log in
entries.answer:
If you just created your account but can't log in:

1. **Verify your email** — Check your inbox for a verification email from Arapoint and click the verification link
2. **Check your credentials** — Make sure you're using the correct email and password used during registration
3. **Try password reset** — Use the 'Forgot Password' link if you're unsure about your password
4. **Clear browser cache** and try again

If the problem persists, contact support with your registered email address.

entries.question: Can I have multiple Arapoint accounts?
entries.answer:
Each person is allowed **one Arapoint account**. Creating multiple accounts using the same identity details is not permitted and may result in account suspension.

If you've forgotten access to your original account, contact support to help you recover it instead of creating a new one.

entries.question: How do I check JAMB CAPS for admission
entries.answer:
JAMB CAPS (Central Admissions Processing System) is where you accept or reject admission offers. Through Arapoint, you can check your CAPS admission status.

To accept/reject on the official JAMB CAPS system:
1. Visit **jamb.org.ng**
2. Log in with your JAMB profile
3. Check your CAPS status and accept/reject offers

Note: Acceptance of admission must be done through the official JAMB portal. Arapoint helps you check the status but the acceptance action must be taken on jamb.org.ng directly.

entries.question: Can I transfer from my Arapoint wallet to another Arapoint user?
variations: send money to another arapoint user
entries.answer:

entries.question: My cable TV subscription was not renewed

dstv still saying expired after payment

   - Smart card/decoder number

   - Transaction reference

Our team will investigate and resolve or refund.

entries.question: What information will I see from a NIN lookup?

entries.question: Can I check if a business name is already registered on Arapoint?

entries.question: What are Arapoint's identity agent services?
variations: what identity services do you offer
entries.answer:
Arapoint offers three Manual Identity Services processed by our trained identity agents:

1. **NIN Validation** — Resolve issues with your NIN record such as 'No Record Found', photograph errors, duplicate NIN, date of birth correction, name correction, or gender correction.

2. **IPE Clearance** — Clear IPE (Identity Process Error) issues on your NIN. After clearance, you receive a new NIMC Tracking ID that replaces your old one.

3. **NIN Personalization** — Update personal details on your NIN record (address, phone, etc.).

All services are paid upfront from your wallet, processed manually by our agents, and you'll receive email notification when your request is completed.

entries.question: What is IPE Clearance?
variations: how long does ipe clearance take
ipe old tracking id new tracking id
entries.answer:
**IPE (Identity Process Error)** is an error that can appear on your NIN record at NIMC, usually indicating a problem with your enrollment or identity record that needs to be resolved manually.

**How Arapoint's IPE Clearance works:**
1. Submit your request on the Identity Agent Services page — provide your 11-digit NIN and your current NIMC Tracking ID
2. The fee is deducted from your wallet
3. Our identity agent picks up your request and works with NIMC to clear the IPE
4. Once cleared, your **old Tracking ID is replaced with a new NIMC Tracking ID**
5. You receive an email notification and the new Tracking ID appears on your dashboard under 'My Requests'

You can view your new tracking ID by going to **Identity Services → My Requests → View** on any completed IPE clearance request.

entries.question: What is NIN Validation?
entries.answer:
**NIN Validation** is a manual service where our identity agents resolve specific issues on your NIN record at NIMC.

**Issues we can resolve:**
• No Record Found
• Photograph Error
• Update Record
• Date of Birth Correction
• Name Correction
• Gender Correction
• Duplicate NIN
• Other Issues

**How it works:**
1. Go to **Identity Services → Manual Identity Services**
2. Select **NIN Validation** and choose your specific issue type
3. Enter your 11-digit NIN and submit — fee is deducted from your wallet
4. Our agent processes your request with NIMC
5. When complete, you receive an email notification and can view the **validated full name and date of birth** from your NIN record on your dashboard under 'My Requests'

The validated name and date of birth are the exact details as recorded at NIMC for your NIN.

entries.question: How do I track my identity service request?
variations: how to check identity service status
how to see my submitted request
entries.answer:
To track your identity service request:

1. Go to **Dashboard → Identity Services → Manual Identity Services**
2. Click the **'My Requests'** tab
3. You'll see all your requests with their tracking IDs (format: ISR-XXXXXX) and status:
   - **Pending** — Waiting to be picked up by an agent
   - **In Progress** — An agent has picked up your request and is processing it
   - **Completed** — Your request has been resolved
4. Click the **eye icon** (View) on any request to see full details including:
   - Exactly what information you submitted (NIN, issue type, tracking ID, notes)
   - Agent feedback and notes
   - For IPE: your new NIMC Tracking ID
   - For Validation: your validated full name and date of birth from NIMC
   - Download link for any result documents

You also receive an **email notification** once your request is marked completed.

entries.question: How long does identity agent service take?
variations: when will my request be done
how long to complete identity service
entries.answer:
Processing times for Arapoint identity agent services vary depending on NIMC response times and request volume:

• **NIN Validation** — Typically 1–3 working days
• **IPE Clearance** — Typically 2–5 working days (depends on NIMC backend processing)
• **NIN Personalization** — Typically 2–5 working days

You can check the current status of your request anytime under **Identity Services → My Requests**. You'll also receive an **email notification** as soon as your request is completed.

If your request has been pending for more than 5 working days, please contact our support team.

entries.question: What is NIN Personalization?
entries.answer:
**NIN Personalization** allows you to update personal details on your NIN record through our identity agents.

**Details you can update:**
• Address
• Phone number
• Other personal information

**How to request:**
1. Go to **Identity Services → Manual Identity Services**
2. Select **NIN Personalization**
3. Enter your 11-digit NIN
4. In the 'Fields to Update' box, list what you want to change (e.g. 'Address: No. 12 Adeola Street, Lagos')
5. Submit — fee is deducted from your wallet

Our agents will process the update with NIMC and notify you by email when done.

entries.question: Why did my identity request get a new tracking ID?
variations: new nimc tracking id after ipe
entries.answer:
When your **IPE Clearance** request is completed, NIMC replaces your old tracking ID with a **new NIMC Tracking ID**.

This is normal and expected — it means the IPE (Identity Process Error) on your NIN has been successfully cleared and NIMC has issued a fresh tracking reference for your record.

**To find your new tracking ID:**
1. Go to **Identity Services → My Requests**
2. Find your IPE Clearance request (status: Completed)
3. Click the **View (eye icon)** button
4. Your new NIMC Tracking ID is displayed prominently in the completed section
5. You also received it in your completion email

Keep your new tracking ID safe — it is now the reference for your NIN record at NIMC.

entries.question: What validated name and date of birth means on my NIN validation result?
entries.answer:
When your **NIN Validation** request is completed by our agent, we retrieve and display:

• **Full Name on Record** — Your full name exactly as it appears in the NIMC database for the NIN you submitted
• **Date of Birth on Record** — Your date of birth exactly as registered at NIMC

These details are provided so you can verify that your NIN record is accurate. If the name or date of birth shown does not match what you expected, please contact our support team.

**To view these details:**
1. Go to **Identity Services → My Requests**
2. Find your NIN Validation request (status: Completed)
3. Click **View** — the validated name and date of birth appear in the completed section

entries.question: How do I fund my Arapoint wallet?

entries.question: Why was money deducted from my wallet for an identity service?
entries.answer:
When you submit an identity agent service request (NIN Validation, IPE Clearance, or NIN Personalization), the service fee is **automatically deducted from your Arapoint wallet** at the time of submission.

This is because our agents begin working on your request immediately after submission, and the fee covers:
• Agent processing time and effort
• NIMC portal access and processing fees
• Administrative costs

The fee amount is always shown on the service selection screen before you submit. If you believe you were charged incorrectly, contact support with your ISR tracking ID.

entries.question: What is the difference between NIN lookup and NIN validation?
variations: difference between nin lookup and validation
entries.answer:
Arapoint offers two types of NIN services:

**NIN Lookup (Instant/Automated)**
• Fetches NIN details instantly from the NIMC database
• Returns name, date of birth, phone, gender, and other details
• Processed automatically — results in seconds
• Used for identity verification purposes

**NIN Validation (Manual/Agent)**
• Used when there is a **problem** with a NIN record that needs to be fixed
• Handled by a trained Arapoint identity agent
• Takes 1–3 working days
• Resolves issues like: No Record Found, Photograph Error, Name/DOB Correction, Duplicate NIN, etc.
• Results include the corrected/validated name and date of birth from NIMC

If you just want to look up someone's NIN details, use the automated NIN Lookup. If you have an issue with your NIN that needs fixing, use NIN Validation.

entries.question: How does Arapoint work?
entries.answer:
Here's how Arapoint works from start to finish:

**Step 1: Create an Account**
Sign up at arapoint.com.ng with your email and phone number. Verify your email to activate your account.

**Step 2: Fund Your Wallet**
All Arapoint services are paid from your wallet. Fund it via bank transfer, card, or USSD from your dashboard.

**Step 3: Use Any Service**
• For **instant services** (NIN Lookup, BVN, Airtime, Data, Electricity, Results): Results are delivered immediately
• For **manual/agent services** (NIN Validation, IPE Clearance, NIN Personalization): Submit your request and an identity agent will process it within 1–5 working days

**Step 4: Receive Your Results**
• Instant services: Results shown immediately on screen
• Agent services: Email notification when complete + view results in 'My Requests'

**Step 5: Track & Download**
All your transactions, request history, and results are stored in your dashboard for future reference.

entries.question: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?

entries.question: How do I buy airtime on Arapoint?

entries.question: How do I pay electricity bill on Arapoint?
variations: how to pay light bill arapoint
entries.answer:

entries.question: My transaction failed but money was deducted from my wallet
entries.answer:

**If still not resolved after 10 minutes:**
1. Check your **Transaction History** in the dashboard for the transaction status
2. Note your **Transaction Reference/ID**
3. Type **'agent'** in this chat to reach our support team
4. Provide your transaction reference, the service you tried to use, and the amount

Our team will investigate and either deliver the service or refund your wallet within 24 hours.

entries.question: How do I check WAEC result on Arapoint?
entries.answer:

2. Enter your **Exam Number** (7 digits + year, e.g. 4031234567)

entries.question: How do I check JAMB result on Arapoint?

entries.question: How do I register my business on Arapoint?
entries.answer:

2. Choose registration type:
   • **Business Name** (sole proprietorship)
   • **Limited Liability Company (LLC)**
   • **Incorporated Trustee** (NGO/church/association)
3. Provide your proposed business name(s) — always have 2–3 alternatives in case one is taken
4. Fill in the required details (proprietors/directors, registered address, business objectives)
5. Upload required documents (ID card, signature, etc.)
6. Pay the processing fee from your wallet
7. Our CAC agent processes your registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission
8. Certificate delivered within 3–7 working days

For questions about required documents, type **'agent'** to speak with our support team.
